Direct shear test on RSM-b soil at relative density 0.53; apparatus: direct shear (University of Notre Dame). Recorded: peak shear load vs normal load (psi).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 22 of the 24 points, and the rest were settled against the scan. Student reviewers have looked at 10 of the 24 points on the scan; none has yet been confirmed by two reviewers (see the provenance page). The test setup is incomplete: specimen height, normal stress, held constant, displacement rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![shear load (maximum shear stress) against normal load (normal stress), SI units. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-ds-fc-7a-dr53.png){.lightbox}

Peak shear load (maximum shear stress) 195.0 kPa at 183.2 kPa normal load (normal stress), the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-7a-dr53/observations.csv) (24 points: 6 plotted symbols, 17 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: shear load (maximum shear stress) in Pa against normal load (normal stress) in Pa; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-7a-dr53/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 533 Pa in normal load (normal stress), 537 Pa in shear load (0.3 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 22 of the 24 points; the other 2 were settled against the scan (read by one reader and verified by the other, or decided between two readings). [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-fc-7a).
